title: Enumerating iterated tilted algebras in type $A$
summary: We show that isoclasses of iterated tilted algebras in type $A_n$ are in bijection with non-crossing spanning trees up to rotation on a convex n+1-gon. This is done by constructing a relationship between iterated tilted algebras up to isomorphism and exceptional sets up to isomorphic Hom-Ext quiver.
